case_purpose: Indirect address and relay alter what must be clarified and who may decide.
must_notice: Courier is the direct addressee and speaker while Briar or Ansel remains the indirect addressee or declared source.
The initial relay leaves the duration of permission underspecified.
The final turn limits today's permission and opens a future direct relation.
may_infer: Relay shapes the conditions under which the permission can be understood and renegotiated.
live_alternatives: The ambiguity may originate in Ansel's first wording rather than in the relay itself.
The final invitation to direct contact may be procedural rather than relationally reparative.
must_not_claim: Ansel and Briar were unable or unwilling to speak directly before this exchange.
Relay has one stable psychological meaning.
